verdict.rationale: Tavily's Search endpoint accepts natural-language questions (e.g. "Who is Leo Messi?"), and qna_search and get_search_context return answers or RAG context from them. An opt-in exact_match flag suggests default matching is not strict keyword or phrase matching. Still, no evidence explicitly says retrieval is meaning-based or semantic, or that it finds results keyword engines miss. missing for 10: explicit documentation of semantic/embedding-based retrieval, evidence or benchmarks showing it surfaces results keyword search misses, independent or hands-on corroboration of relevance quality
